newsitem.title: GERMANY: Retail wage talks resume in German Saar region.
newsitem.headline: Retail wage talks resume in German Saar region.

text.p: Wage talks for some 43,000 retail workers in the Saar region resumed on Thursday morning, likely moving towards a deal, employee officials said.
"We expect an agreement today," a spokeswoman for the union HBV said in Saarbruecken, where the talks are being held.
Sources close to the negotiations said they expected the deal to be modeled along the lines of an agreement reached with Bavarian retail workers earlier this week.
The union and employers there agreed on a 1.85 percent pay rise and a non-cash allowance for the planned extension of shopping hours for around 320,000 shop workers in Bavaria.
The deal was backdated to May 1 and will run for 12 months.
